_comment: The Kalinov Bridge (PLAN.md §10), built in the Holy City in five stages. Each stage needs its cost in resources, drawn from the group's vault (caravans bring resources there), its embers (Svarog's Ember from lairs and ancient sites) and its quests, all done while the stage is open; it then takes buildHours game hours to raise. Each stage and each of its quests carries the story of why the bridge needs it. Quest kinds: relic (explore the stage's quest ruin, `questPlaces.relic`, raised when the stage opens, heavily guarded), grove (clear the stage's quest lair, `questPlaces.grove`), defense (beat the stage's quest army, `questPlaces.defense`: a host of its own, apart from the hordes, that sets out delayHours after the stage opens and marches on the Holy City; if it is not beaten, another comes retryHours after), artifact (an army raids the North to its full depth and sacks its stronghold), ritual (craft a ritual item from ritualEmbers embers); the older kinds site, lair, unscathed and choke are kept for old saves. While a stage is raised, every active front sends one small horde at a different target (`constructionRaids`: units + unitsPerStage x the stage's number): the group's villages first, then the Holy City. Every finished stage makes waves powerPerStage bigger (group power), and brings every member its reward: resources to their first village, and a blessing (effects, like research) that lasts the rest of the run. When the fifth stage stands, Ritual Night comes.
story: Beyond the Holy City the Kalinov Bridge crosses the Smorodina, the river of fire, from Nav to Yav, the living world, and every horde that comes walks over it. The volkhvs mean to raise it on from Yav to Prav, the realm of the gods: once the Ritual Arch joins it to Prav, the gods' light runs down the whole bridge and nothing from Nav can set foot on it again. The hordes know this, and will throw everything at the city on the night the arch is bound.

stages.name: Foundation Stones

quests.story: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span.

stages.story: A road to Prav can't rise from common stone. The old builders were buried with the rune that made their stones remember the rite; only stones marked with it will carry the bridge on from Yav.

stages.name: The Oak Piers

quests.story: The sacred oaks stand over a den of Nav's beasts, grown fat on the grove's offerings. Clear the Den under the Sacred Oaks, or no volkhv will lift an axe in the grove.

stages.story: The piers that lift the bridge towards Prav are cut from the sacred oaks, but Veles' beasts have made their den among the roots and nobody can fell a tree while they howl.

stages.name: The Iron Span

quests.story: Nav knows the forge is lit. The Smith-Breakers, a host sworn to put out Svarog's flame, march on the Holy City apart from the hordes: beat them before the walls, and the iron can be forged.

stages.story: Iron forged under Svarog's eye carries the road up into the sky. The forge in the Holy City must burn without break, and Nav will send its own to put it out.

stages.name: The Guardian Rails

quests.story: The Eye of Veles, the stone that sees every road from Nav, is kept in the North's deepest stronghold. Raid the North to its full depth, sack the stronghold and bring the Eye back: set in the rails, it shows the guardians everything that comes.

stages.story: The rails are carved with the faces of guardians so that nothing from Nav can climb the new span to Prav; but guardians must see to guard, and only the Eye of Veles sees the roads of Nav.

stages.name: The Ritual Arch

quests.story: Forge the ritual torc from a Svarog's Ember: the volkhvs bind the arch with it, and without it the new span is only a road into Prav for the enemy.

stages.story: The arch at the top of the span opens onto Prav. It is bound with a torc of Svarog's fire, and once it stands, everything in Nav will come at once: Ritual Night.

relic.name: The Builders' Rune
relic.description: Explore the Builders' Barrow, deep in guardians, while this stage is open.

grove.name: The Den under the Sacred Oaks
grove.description: Clear the quest lair while this stage is open.

defense.name: Beat the Smith-Breakers
defense.description: Beat the quest army marching on the Holy City.

artifact.name: The Eye of Veles
artifact.description: Raid the North to its full depth and sack its stronghold while this stage is open.

ritual.name: Craft the ritual torc
ritual.description: Forge the ritual torc from a Svarog's Ember.

site.name: Bring back a relic
site.description: Explore an ancient site while this stage is open.

lair.name: Clear a monster lair
lair.description: An army clears a lair of the North while this stage is open.

unscathed.name: Weather a wave unscathed
unscathed.description: A wave ends without the Holy City losing Sanctity since this stage began.

choke.name: Hold a strong point
choke.description: Win a field battle at a choke point or from a fort while this stage is open.

ritualNight.story: With the arch raised, the volkhvs begin the rite that will join the bridge to Prav. Every horde in Nav feels it. Tonight they all come at once, from every front, to break the city before the last words are spoken.

won.title: The Kalinov Bridge holds
won.story: The last horde broke against the walls and the rite was finished. The Kalinov Bridge runs from Nav through Yav to Prav, the gods' light holds it end to end, the road from Nav is shut, and the bells of the Holy City ring for the first time in a generation. The old faith lives on, because you held.

lost.title: The Holy City has fallen
lost.story: The walls are breached and the sanctuary fires are out. The hordes pour over the Kalinov Bridge unopposed. Some of the people escaped into the forests, carrying the songs with them; perhaps one day they will try again.

grove.name: The Den under the Sacred Oaks
